message:
fix(ldk-server): wait for payment history in regtests

LDK Server can report a successful payment by ID before its event handler
adds the payment to history. Immediate hash lookups could therefore fail
with "Payment not found" in the BOLT11 send and gRPC melt scenarios.

Reuse the bounded terminal-state polling helper for both hash lookups and
the gRPC payment-ID check. Add lookup context to failures and document the
history delay in the README and changelog.

Validation: all 30 unit tests and the full regtest suite passed against
local bitcoind and LDK Server daemons. Formatting and Clippy also passed.
